functions.purpose: Map 12-bit NTC ADC at VADC 0x48030B04 through a 40-point ascending table (0x100071DC, 385..944) to assist percent 100..61. RunRideControlLoop averages 4 samples and derates current below 75 / 92 percent. ADC>=944 forces 60%.

immediates.meaning: minimum 60% assist when NTC ADC>=944 (thermal floor)
uint16 NTC ADC thresholds for 100% down to 61%

functions.purpose: 12-bit read of VADC 0x48030700+0x1C. Same register as ReadAdcChannelHigh; RAM veneer thunk_FUN_10002450 calls this copy.
12-bit read of VADC 0x48030700+0. Same register as ReadAdcChannelLow; RAM veneer copy.
12-bit read of VADC 0x48030B00+0 (same bank as NTC +4, battery current +0x18, torque-like +0x1C).
Flash wrapper that BL thunk_EXT_FUN_2000070a. Called from RunRideControlLoop before DisableMotorOutput during PWM/driver bring-up.

Inverse of DisableMotorOutput: clear ride PWM state, capture P1 hall bits, apply hall sector pattern, add ~30 electrical-degree offset, set enable flag, start CCU8-like timer at 0x50010040 (write 0x333 to +4, set bit2 at +8, set status bits 0x100/8/4, clear bit4).

immediates.meaning: motor status word+4 bit 8 set on enable
timer+8 shadow/start bit and status bit 2
PWM timer compare/period written to 0x50010044 on enable (0 on disable)

functions.purpose: Direction bit at 0x20002694 selects forward vs reverse hall-sector tables (0x200024DC / 0x200024E8). Calls RAM CORDIC/sector helper JumpToRamSlot2422, writes MCM/period pattern to 0x50010034, sets timer+8 bit.

immediates.meaning: direction test via lsls #0x17 on status+4

functions.purpose: Read XMC P1_IN at 0x40040124 and mask bits [2:0] (3-bit hall state).
Map hall state through signed-byte sector map at 0x2000250A (+0 fwd, +8 rev) into uint16 angle table at 0x1000722C; reverse path adds extra offset word.
Store source pointer at ride-state+0x34 and copy 255 bytes into 0x2000296C. Called from RunRideControlLoop init with a flash config pointer.
Swap args and BLX function pointer at *0x104. Returns 1 unless hook result==0x10000 (256-byte compare/commit success).

immediates.meaning: vector/hook pointer used as block compare
expected success code for 256-byte block match

functions.purpose: Byte memcpy(src, dst, len) with 16-bit index; used to snapshot the 256-byte config block.
Copy 256-byte config image, patch bytes at (addr-base)&0xFF, then InvokeBlockCompareVector. Returns true on compare failure.
Hour delta between two packed date/time words at 0x20002AF4 using 8760 (year), 720 (month*30d), 24 (day). Stores signed hours at ride-state+0x1C; dispatcher treats <721 as in-warranty/service window.
If analog at 0x2000269C is in [900,1131) decrement ride-state+6; else increment up to 150. Analog-in-band hold / out-of-band slew (torque/current window).
Read FUN_100023ee (VADC 0x48030B00+0x14), store at ride-state+0x20, slew byte +5 toward 0..15. Threshold is ADC + (-1843) < 410 i.e. ADC < 2253.

immediates.meaning: 410 after adding signed offset -1843 (aux ADC slew trip)

functions.purpose: If voltage-like <=600 or speed/current-like <=4000 or status bits fail, decay debounce and clear 0x200000. Else increment to 500 (4000>>3) then set running-permit bit 0x200000.
Priority-encode status bits at 0x20002690 into fault code 1..11 at fault-state+5. Codes are held off until a 30-count debounce at DAT_10002B54 expires.
When measured current < limit and voltage is below limit/2 and limit/8, set headroom steps=(limit-measured-70)>>5 and slew a 0..12 assist/offset byte. Jump-load if slew==0 and steps>3.
Every 13 ticks of ride-state+2, run FUN_100022e4 (24-byte display TX checksum/copy into USIC-like regs).

5-slot outer / 10-slot inner motor ISR scheduler: RAM FOC/current/PWM slots plus display checksum, 300-count flag timeout, 2.5x current target, fault/run/aux/window/datetime helpers. Stall timer 0..1000 at ride-state+0x10.

immediates.meaning: 20 packed-field threshold with 720h check for flag 0x100000
current target = raw*2 + raw>>1 into control+0x12 when motor bit set

functions.purpose: If motor-enable bit set and any of 3 consecutive signed phase/current samples +299 is below limit AND commanded current > floor, ramp ride-state+0x1E to 1000; else decay. Clears timer when related flags drop.
